results.note: Official lviv.travel and In Your Pocket pages list hours but no ticket price. Only a user-submitted Wanderlog note says about 100 UAH, which is not official, so I did not report it.
The fountain is an open-air monument on Rynok Square. Only third-party guides (audiala, prolviv) say the square is free. I found no official or ticketing page that states a price for the fountain.
